title: The Widow of Zarephath
description: During the great drought, God sends the prophet Elijah to a poor widow in Zarephath. She shares her last flour and oil with him, and as the Lord promised, neither the jar of flour nor the jug of oil runs out.

versions.title: The Widow of Zarephath
versions.description: During the great drought, God sends Elijah to a poor widow in Zarephath. Her flour and oil do not run out, just as the Lord had promised through the prophet.
versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal covers both the food miracle (vv. 8–16) and the raising of the son (vv. 17–24). The latter already exists as a separate story 'Elijah raises the widow's son'. It is better to limit this one to vv. 8–16 concerning the food miracle, so that the two stories do not overlap.; [minor] description: The description mentions only the food miracle, but the references extend to v. 24, which deals with the death and raising of the son. Limiting it makes the description more precise.
